name: Status icon
summary: A progress glyph for anything that can be started and finished (a lesson, a task, a step) — not started, in progress, completed — with state colour from DS tokens.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-status-icon> — the reusable form of a progress status glyph. It composes <aha-icon> (system-check-circle, system-circle-dashed) with state colour from --aha-* tokens, so in-progress has its own glyph; not-started and completed share system-check-circle and differ by colour, with the accessible name carrying the state. Carries role="img" with an accessible name that defaults to the state; pass a translated `label` in the product. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by tokens.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render across frameworks.

props.name: status

props.name: size
props.desc: Glyph size in px; any other value falls back to 16

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name; pass a translated string in the product

whenToUse.when: showing how far one item (lesson, task, step) has progressed, in a list, rail or header
a lifecycle pill with a text label for a domain object (draft, published, closed)
a quantity along a bar, such as 3 of 7 lessons done

opinion.note: Pair it with the item title or a visible label where the state matters; in-progress has its own glyph, but not-started and completed share the check-circle and differ by colour, so the accessible name and nearby text carry the state. Not-started uses the check-circle glyph in grey: the registry has no plain circle glyph, so a hollow circle needs a DS icon first.
